import os,sys,unittest

from tests.job_manager.fixtures import *
from baton_v12.job_manager import submit, sweep, status
from baton_v12.job_manager import delegation, projection
from baton_v12.contracts import ContractRefusal

class T(JobManagerCase):
    def runTest(self):
        jobs=self.store(); acts=FakeOperations()
        submit(jobs, submission()); sweep(jobs, acts, now=NOW)
        seen=[]
        real=delegation.observation_of
        def watched(o,s,h):
            seen.append(jobs._connection.in_transaction); return real(o,s,h)
        delegation.observation_of=watched
        try:
            with jobs.read_snapshot():
                try:
                    status(jobs, acts, observed_at=NOW)
                except ContractRefusal as r:
                    print('REFUSED', r.category, r.code); print(str(r))
                print('still open:', jobs._connection.in_transaction)
        finally:
            delegation.observation_of=real
        print('observations:', seen)
t=T(); unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=0).run(unittest.TestSuite([t]))
